channel.title: Treasure Coast Today
channel.description: Local news for Martin, St. Lucie and Indian River counties, Florida.

item.title: Two men killed in early morning shooting on Southeast Rivergreen Circle in Port St. Lucie
item.description:
Port St. Lucie Police Department is investigating a double fatal shooting that occurred early Sunday morning in a residential neighborhood. Officers responded around 3:30 a.m. to the 1300 block of Southeast Rivergreen Circle after receiving multiple 911 calls reporting gunshots.

item.title: Safe Kids Treasure Coast offering free pool alarms to Martin County residents
item.description: The Florida Department of Health and Safe Kids Treasure Coast are providing a limited supply of free pool alarms to qualifying Martin County residents with residential pools.

item.title: JetBlue cancels Vero Beach to JFK route in September due to low demand
item.description: JetBlue is canceling its flight route between Vero Beach Regional Airport and New York's JFK Airport, with the last flights operating on Sept. 9. item.title: Treasure Coast residents avoid lettuce amid E. coli and cyclospora outbreaks
item.description: Families across the Treasure Coast are changing their diets to avoid contaminated produce linked to E. coli and cyclospora outbreaks, with five confirmed local cases since May.

item.title: Spain Defeats Argentina 1-0 to Win 2026 World Cup in Extra Time
item.description: Spain defeated Argentina 1-0 to win the 2026 FIFA World Cup championship in a match that remained scoreless through regulation time. item.title: Britain's Josh Kerr Breaks Mile World Record in London
item.description: Josh Kerr ran the mile in 3:42.66 Saturday at a Diamond League event in London, breaking a 27-year-old world record.

item.title: Major League Baseball Restricts iPad Use to Prevent AI Decision Making
item.description: MLB made custom tabs on dugout iPads inaccessible to teams starting Wednesday night to prevent artificial intelligence from helping make in-game decisions.

item.title: Security Ramped Up for World Cup Final at New Jersey Stadium
item.description: The World Cup final Sunday received a Level 1 Special Event designation, the highest possible security classification, with President Trump attending the trophy presentation.

item.title: Lionel Messi and Lamine Yamal Face Off in World Cup Final 19 Years After Photo Shoot
item.description: A 2007 photo shoot captured teenage Lionel Messi bathing infant Lamine Yamal for a UNICEF charity calendar. The two now meet in Sunday's World Cup final.

item.title: Snyder Drives in Five as St. Lucie Mets Hold Off Cardinals, 8-6
item.description:

item.title: Boca Raton TLC Program Offers Summer Service Projects for South Florida Families
item.description: B'nai Torah Congregation's TLC Program connects volunteers with hands-on service projects ranging from food support and shoe donations to pantry stocking and literacy efforts.

item.title: Byron Donalds, David Jolly Lead Florida Governor's Race as Primary Nears

item.title: Two Martin County brush fires contained, more expected this summer
item.description: Martin County saw two brush fires this week, including one sparked by a lightning strike, both now fully contained and being monitored by the Florida Forest Service.

item.title: St. Lucie County Fire District terminates 3 firefighters, suspends 2 others after hazing investigation
item.description: An independent investigation found senior firefighters used a modified bug zapper to administer electric shocks to probationary and apprentice firefighters while on duty. The incidents occurred during shifts in March and September 2024.

item.title: Unity in the Community event connects Fort Pierce families with services and public safety demonstrations
item.description: The annual Fort Pierce event brought together families with community resources and public safety demonstrations.

item.title: St. Lucie County workplace culture assessment found intense peer pressure at Station 1A
item.description: A 2025 workplace culture assessment by attorney Susan Gainey found Station 1A had an environment marked by intense peer pressure, social exclusion and light hazing.
